newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end flat, CANTV, Electricidad slip.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end flat, CANTV, Electricidad slip.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed broadly flat as gains in financial stocks were balanced by falls in telephone company CANTV and utility Electricidad de Caracas, traders said.

News of a 12 hour strike Monday by CANTV workers left the market largely unmoved, said traders. "There was some selling at the end of the session, but the stock was already heading down," Multinvest broker Mario Simosa told Reuters.
The bolsa's 19-share index edged ahead 0.53 percent in light trade to end at 6,716.33 points as 14 million shares exchanged worth 1.7 billion bolivars ($3.6 million).
Among traded issues, 23 rose, 18 fell and seven closed flat. Leading local bank Merinvest's composite which includes CANTV, slipped 0.08 percent to close at 103.67 points.
"The market was basically quiet ... waiting on news," said Cavelba broker Harold Cuellar.
Electricidad slipped a hair paring 0.7 bolivars off its opening price to end at 530.00.
